topic: Write an Introduction to a Comedian(写一篇喜剧演员介绍)
title_en: A Comedian Who Makes Me Laugh
genre: 博客 / 人物介绍(introduce a comedian: who, why you like them, their funniest work, your comment)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修一 Unit 1 Presenting/Writing:choose a comedian who makes you laugh and write a short introduction(参照课本 Charlie Chaplin 博客结构)。
prompt_cn: 请用英语写一篇约 80 词的短文,向同学介绍一位让你发笑的喜剧演员,内容包括:① 简要介绍他/她是谁;② 你为什么喜欢他/她;③ 他/她最好笑的一部作品或一个片段;④ 你的评价。注意尽量用上非限制性定语从句(如 …, who … / …, which …)。
prompt_en: Write a short text (about 80 words) introducing a comedian who makes you laugh. Include: 1) a brief introduction to who they are; 2) why you like them; 3) their funniest work or scene; 4) your own comment. Try to use non-defining relative clauses (e.g. …, who … / …, which …).
points: 介绍是谁(… is a comedian / actor who …)
为什么喜欢(I like him/her because …)
最好笑的作品或片段(His funniest scene is …, which …)
你的评价 + 尽量用非限制性定语从句
model_essay: My favourite comedian is Charlie Chaplin, who became famous when films were still silent. I love him because he could make people laugh without saying a single word. His most famous character is the Tramp, who is a poor but kind-hearted little man. In my favourite film, Modern Times, the Tramp falls behind on a factory line, which always makes me roar with laughter. Chaplin showed that humour, which needs no language, can bring joy to people all over the world.
model_translation: 我最喜欢的喜剧演员是查理·卓别林,他在电影还是无声片的年代就出了名。我喜欢他,因为他不用说一个字就能逗人发笑。他最著名的角色是流浪汉,一个贫穷却善良的小人物。在我最爱的电影《摩登时代》里,流浪汉在工厂流水线上跟不上节奏,这总能让我哄堂大笑。卓别林证明了:无需语言的幽默能给全世界的人带来欢乐。

rubric.criteria: 四要素齐全:是谁 / 为什么喜欢 / 最好笑的作品或片段 / 你的评价
条理清楚、句句相关、代词指代清楚、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、非限制性定语从句运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 介绍是谁 … is a comedian who …
为什么喜欢 I like him/her because …
最好笑片段 His funniest scene is …, which …
评价 … showed that humour, which …, can …
key_expressions: My favourite comedian is Charlie Chaplin, who became famous in the silent-film age.
He could make people laugh without saying a single word.
His most famous character is the Tramp, who is a poor but kind-hearted man.
The Tramp falls behind on a factory line, which always makes me roar with laughter.

high_sentences: My favourite comedian is Charlie Chaplin, who became famous when films were still silent.
His most famous character is the Tramp, who is a poor but kind-hearted little man.
The Tramp falls behind on a factory line, which always makes me roar with laughter.
Chaplin showed that humour, which needs no language, can bring joy to people everywhere.

error_pairs.wrong: Charlie Chaplin, that became famous, made silent films.
error_pairs.correct: Charlie Chaplin, who became famous, made silent films.
error_pairs.note: 非限制性定语从句指人用 who,绝不用 that。

error_pairs.wrong: He fell into a cake, that made everyone laugh.
error_pairs.correct: He fell into a cake, which made everyone laugh.
error_pairs.note: 逗号后指代整句话用 which,不用 that。

error_pairs.wrong: The Tramp, who his heart is kind, helps others.
error_pairs.correct: The Tramp, whose heart is kind, helps others.
error_pairs.note: 表所属(他的心)用 whose,不用 who。
